title: Count with a range
summary: Kotlin: Count with a range. Change the end to 4.
introduction: The range 1..3 includes both ends. for reads each number. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Count with a range with Kotlin

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.
The .. range includes 3, so there are three loop values.
